changeSet.author: McNamee
changeSet.sql: CREATE or ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetSecurityAssetUid] ( @SecurityAsset varchar(1), @SecurityAssetID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select A.[UID], gr.firstname + ' ' + gr.LastName as 'Name' from [dbo].[Asset] A inner join reporting.global_resource gr on A.objectid = gr.resourceid where A.[Object] = 'Resource' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'R' union all select A.[UID], g.name as 'Name' from [dbo].[Asset] A inner join [dbo].[Group] g on A.ObjectID = g.id where A.[Object] = 'Group' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'G' union all select A.[UID], o.name as 'Name' from [dbo].[Asset] A inner join [dbo].[Organization] o on A.ObjectID = o.ID where A.[Object] = 'Organization' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'O' )
